carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent longitudinal ridge is visible extending horizontally across the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance gradient with a high-intensity highlights on the superior margin and cast shadows on the inferior margin.

other_distinctive_markers: A high-luminance, spindle-shaped silhouette (remora) is attached to the mid-lateral flank, presenting a significant local contrast against the darker dorsal coloration.
